outcome: decrease of transcutaneous saturation (TcSO2) and heart rate during surfactant delivery
change in partial pressure of oxygen/fraction of inspired oxygen value before and after drug delivery
cohort: The study included premature infants with respiratory distress syndrome (RDS).
finding: LISA combined with NIV treatment in premature infants with RDS was clinically efficacious and significantly reduced the incidence of bronchopulmonary dysplasia compared to traditional INSURE.
